title: Existence of GL-Good Factorization
body_html:
Existence of GL-Good Factorization

Every tamely ramified semisimple \(\Gamma\in\mathbf g\) admits a \(G\)-good factorization whose positive-depth terms are already good in the ambient general linear group. Moreover, a GL-good element is \(G\)-good for the classical group.
proof_html: The proof writes \(F^0[\Gamma]\) as a product of tame field factors. At the lowest valuation, roots of unity and Hensel lifting produce a leading approximation with eigenvalue differences either zero or of the required valuation. Subtracting this leading term increases depth, so the process terminates. The restriction from general linear roots to classical roots gives GL-good implies \(G\)-good.
